title: The Bank Loan
situation: Your bankers will extend emergency credit — but only because your reputation still means something. The cash buys you time; the debt will bleed you for quarters to come and Finance will never let you forget it.

options.label: Take the emergency loan
options.description: Injects cash now. Adds debt: a recurring drain and a Finance morale hit.
options.outcomeText: The wire hits your account. So does the weight of the repayment schedule.
